about: The two reference models: the ones this engine is measured on and a first run starts from. Any other gguf comes from its own Hugging Face repository, through the Models screen, where the server reads its header before the download and says what it is and whether it fits.

models.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
models.blurb: 3B active of 35B. Hybrid attention/SSM, comfortably past RAM. The published numbers use this one.

models.title: Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it
models.blurb: 4B active of 26B. Smaller experts, the gentlest start.
